resume_point: Round dh: unheld standard histories, checked against every branch first: Niebuhr's Lectures on Ancient History (tr. Schmitz, 3 vols, if not already on the niebuhr shelf), Wachsmuth's Historical Antiquities of the Greeks (tr. Woolrych), Nathaniel Hooke's Roman History, Thomas Arnold's History of Rome; then a fourth IA subject sweep (Greek drama criticism, Roman literature histories, the Homeric question, numismatics, classical geography, Byzantine literature).
